name: Spicy Chili-Garlic Caramelized Pork Bowl with Carrots, Cucumber & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium and 4 small food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 English cucumber
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Divide between the 4 small storage containers.
Peel and trim carrots, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of each carrot to make ribbons. Add to the containers with the cucumber, cover, and refrigerate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, chili-garlic sauce, and salt; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add pork to the skillet and cook, breaking it meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Set aside.
Add sugar and fish sauce to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, undisturbed, for 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp brown sugar
4 tsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Stir the pork, then continue to cook, undisturbed, until the sugar begins to caramelize and pork becomes dark brown, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes.
When the rice is done, transfer to a large baking sheet pan, spread out in an even layer, and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes.

When the rice is cool, divide between the medium storage containers along with pork and green onion. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Heat pork and rice in an oven or microwave, then top with cucumbers and carrots. Enjoy!
